column1: # Percept symbol table for planet/language/percepts.py (builder A, 2026-11-03). Sounds are stored as heard.
# One row per symbol; axis columns as in percepts.AXES (blank = 0). Rows marked 'diacritic composition' are what the parser
# composes from a base row plus diacritics (tests check that); they are listed for coverage and documentation.
# source: ipa (IPA 2020 chart) | extipa (extIPA 2015/2024) | voqs (Voice Quality Symbols, Ball, Esling & Dickson 2018) | house.
# vowel height: 0 open, 1 near-open, 2 open-mid, 3 mid, 4 close-mid, 5 near-close, 6 close (the IPA chart rows); back: 0 front .. 4 back.
# tone: 1 low 2 mid 3 high 4 rising 5 falling 6 extra-high 7 extra-low. register: -1 sub-bass, +1 ultra.

column24: U+0261 script g; ASCII g is an alias
epiglottal stop, stored as the pharyngeal stop
beak/mandible clap, heard as a hollow mid-spectrum knock; symbol is the IPA velar click letter withdrawn in 1970, reused
harsh/growl phonation: VoQS ventricular V‼ as a segment suffix
purr phonation (ᵣ U+1D63, Phonetic Extensions): ~25 Hz pulsed voicing on both breath phases
second simultaneous source (syrinx two-voice; ᴖ U+1D16)
sub-bass register (˯ U+02EF): carried below ~20 Hz
ultra register (˰ U+02F0): above human hearing
